# Requirements Document: Accepting a payment

## Introduction

The checks the airline makes before it takes a payment for order items: the
items' payment time limits, the currencies, the commitment method, and whether
the requested amounts add up to the items' price.  Each payment method is then
charged its requested amount plus its surcharge.

These requirements are generated from the Lean model in [`Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Accept.lean`](https://github.com/samdengler/verified-air/blob/main/Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Accept.lean). Each acceptance criterion carries the status the build computed for it: *proven* means a theorem the build checked, *example only* means a computed example, *open* means a theorem the build could not prove, and *not checked* means no theorem or example covers it yet.

## Requirements

### Requirement ONE-304

**User Story:** As an airline, I want each payment checked against the items it pays for, so that items are paid in full and on time, and each method is charged its amount plus its surcharge.

**Rule:** WHEN a seller pays for order items THE SYSTEM SHALL accept the payment only if it is made before the items' payment time limits and its requested amounts add up to their price, and shall charge each payment method its requested amount plus its surcharge. (Lean: `acceptPayment`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the airline accepts a payment THE SYSTEM SHALL charge each payment method its requested amount plus its surcharge.
   - ONE-304.1, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_charges`; example `splitPaymentCharges`
2. IF the requested amounts of a payment do not add up to the price of the order items it covers THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment.
   - ONE-304.2, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_requested_eq_price`; example `surchargeCountedAsPrice`
3. WHEN the airline accepts a payment THE SYSTEM SHALL charge in total the price of the order items it covers plus the surcharges of its payment methods.
   - ONE-304.3, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_total`; example `splitPaymentCharges`
4. IF a payment is made at or after the payment time limit of an order item it covers THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment.
   - ONE-304.4, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_rejects_after_time_limit`; example `paymentAfterTimeLimit`
5. IF a payment uses the commitment method with an amount other than zero THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment.
   - ONE-304.5, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_commitment_zero`; example `commitmentForFreeSeat`
6. IF a payment uses the commitment method for order items with an amount to pay THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment.
   - ONE-304.6, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_commitment_zero`; example `commitmentBesideCard`; example `commitmentForFreeSeat`
7. IF a payment has no payment method THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment.
   - ONE-304.7, proven: proven theorem `acceptPayment_rejects_without_method`
